a48_bullet: - **The looser reading of turns does not rescue light's charges (A48; its counting checked by me).** "Turns up to a local relabeling" has two halves. With one fixed relabeling pattern it is your exact turns written in other labels: nothing physical changes, and all three costs in decision 28 stay (exact). The only genuinely looser option lets some places' possibilities stop turning with the grid. That allows a one-part charged hop through light's links and lets the painted sign pattern keep all 24 turns (if sideways steps may combine up to an overall sign). But light's charges stay bosons under every version, as long as the grid's three straight half-turns about each corner are kept (exact for the simple ways of dressing hops; checked). Keeping only one half-turn would allow electron-like charges, but the grid's turns include all three.
